heading: Behind the edit
body: I'm a video producer and animator based in Louisiana. I write, shoot, edit and animate, so one person carries a project from the first idea to the final export.
Most of my work is for brands and healthcare teams: logo animations, documentary stories about real people, and motion graphics that make the numbers easy to follow.
If you have a story to tell, I'd like to hear it.
name: Matt Guidry
title: Video Producer & Animator
